scope: One paired development continuation from the same complete scratch-trained PPO state; not a convergence claim.
verified_source_checks: depth-h512-lambda095: completed source identity, rollout likelihood/memory and fixed48 replay; reuse without recomputation.
comparison: Existing depth-h512-lambda1, horizon512, lambda1, 64 worlds, 64 minibatches, 4 epochs.
hypothesis: Single-trajectory minibatches and many sequential optimizer steps can amplify noisy long-return policy updates. Increasing the number of independent trajectories per step and reducing optimizer steps per interaction may preserve successful behavior.
held_fixed: Complete source actor/critic/moments/RNG/environment/memory, horizon512, lambda1, gamma1, both learning rates, 4 epochs, reward, curriculum denominator, KL limit, scoped deterministic update, evaluation cases and intervals.
decision: At actual final update require at least80% retention of the21 source successes for promotion; compare all three checks against the64-minibatch lambda1 control. Report new/lost cases and actual executed/skipped steps. No best-checkpoint substitution.
limitation: Changing minibatch count changes both minibatch composition/size and optimizer-step count. This comparison cannot isolate those two mechanisms. Full scratch3-seed convergence and900000-interaction stability remain separate requirements.
reference_scope: On-policy training choices require controlled empirical comparison; the proposed benefit in this recurrent drone setup is an inference to test, not a result from that paper.
